extensionDescription.message: Never hear the spike — protect your ears across the web

limit.description: Label for max loudness slider on home

ceilingHint.description: Explains the ceiling slider when even-volume is off

ceilingHintEven.message: Peaks are stopped; quiet and loud parts are also evened out
ceilingHintEven.description: Ceiling hint when even-volume leveling is on

mainToggleTitle.description: Title for the main toggle button

pathToggleTitle.message: Switch between Best quality and Fullscreen-friendly

pathBestDesc.message: Captures the whole tab so peaks are stopped before you hear them. Only one tab gets Best quality at a time — others stay protected in Fullscreen-friendly mode. Player fullscreen may need F11.

releaseTooltip.message: How fast volume comes back after a peak is cut. Slow = smoothest, Fast = least pumping on music.

applyAllSitesTooltip.message: Keeps this setting on every site (overrides per-site memory).

levelingTooltip.message: Evens quiet and loud parts before the peak limiter. Turn off for Music-style dynamics.

statusModeEven.description: Status mode when leveling is on

statusModePeaks.description: Status mode when leveling is off

statusPathPaused.description: Status-line path fragment when HQ could not start here

reductionLabel.description: How much the limiter is turning the sound down right now

statusPathStandby.description: Path fragment when HQ is on another tab

statusPathUnavailable.message: Best quality paused — tap to resume
statusPathUnavailable.description: Path fragment when HQ wants to run here but could not start

reviewPromptText.message: Enjoying Decibel Limiter? A short review helps a lot.

coachmarkIntro.message: Enable protection, set a ceiling, pick a mode. That’s the whole loop.

coachmarkPower.message: Turn protection on here. The number shows your current level in dBFS.

coachmarkScenarios.message: Night/Balanced/Social even volume + a ceiling. Music is peaks only — keeps dynamics.

coachmarkEvenVolume.message: Even volume smoothes quiet and loud parts. Ceiling always stops peaks above the line.

coachmarkBestQuality.message: Best quality stops peaks before you hear them. Use Fullscreen-friendly if you need the player's fullscreen.

coachmarkGlobalToggle.message: Apply to all sites overrides per-site memory. Otherwise each domain is remembered.

fullscreenHint.message: Best quality is on — player fullscreen stays limited. Press F11 for true fullscreen, or switch to Fullscreen-friendly in Settings.
